description: Projects an Australian superannuation balance to retirement (employer contributions, salary sacrifice, after-tax contributions, contribution tax and current caps, fees, inflation) and then retirement spending: the balance at retirement in nominal and today's dollars, a level annual budget, the gap to a target income and the age the money runs out. The Age Pension amount is an input; eligibility is not calculated. All fields are required; amounts in AUD, rates in percent per year.

afterTax.description: After-tax contribution, AUD per month in today's money

agePension.description: User-supplied Age Pension estimate, AUD per year in today's money; eligibility not calculated

annualFixedFees.description: Fixed fees, AUD per year in today's money

employerRate.description: Employer contribution assumption, percent of salary; not a payroll liability calculation

endAge.description: Projection end age; must exceed retirement age; whole years.

growth.description: Nominal annual return after investment earnings tax, before fees, percent

include_projection.description: Also return annual cash-flow rows (default false: a compact summary).

pensionAge.description: User-supplied Age Pension payment start age; whole years.

retirementAge.description: Retirement age; at least current age and 60; accumulation ends by 75; whole years.

salarySacrifice.description: Extra pre-tax contribution, AUD per month in today's money

targetIncome.description: Target retirement spending, AUD per year in today's money

name: calculate_australia_super
title: Australian super projection
